intro: Enjoy healing time with your family through soothing mandala coloring!
description:
Escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life and find peace of mind by coloring beautiful mandala patterns!
<Crayon Mandala> goes beyond the existing Crayon series for children and is a healing coloring simulation game that the whole family, including parents and adults, can enjoy together.

A variety of elaborate mandala patterns await your touch. Relieve stress and experience inner peace by completing the mandala with your own color combination.

■ The special charm of <Crayon Mandala>
Healing for the whole family: The perfect art therapy game for kids to get creative and adults to relax.
Elaborate and beautiful patterns: From simple drawings to artistic mandalas, there are a variety of patterns available.
Intuitive operation: Without complicated tools, anyone can easily fill in beautiful colors by touching the screen.
Artwork Gallery: You can save your completed mandala in the gallery and view it again at any time.

Experience the time of filling a mandala with your own colors with quiet music.
